profile_text.body:
Genpact LTD is recorded as a for-profit public company with headquarters in Hamilton, D0, trading under the ticker G, with CIK 0001398659. The website associated with the company in the record is generali.com.

The text harvested from that site describes Assicurazioni Generali Group, not Genpact. It presents the corporate website as a source for information about the group's activities, financial data, news, corporate social responsibility, career opportunities, and history, alongside what it calls storytelling on topics of general interest. The site also refers to a plan called 'Lifetime Partner 27: Driving Excellence', which it says will further enhance excellence across customer relationships, the group operating model, and core capabilities. The company describes itself in those terms.

No AI products are listed for the company, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded. The only other held facts are the corporate identifiers and location noted above.
